falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes above 5,600 on any day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A new all-time high would invalidate the 'bottom_2024_aug' pattern match, as that pattern resolved with lower lows; this confirms continuation not reversal

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 14.00 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained complacency contradicts a bottoming regime; the pattern requires elevated/falling-from-elevated volatility, not pre-crisis calm

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% and holds there for 2+ days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Flight-to-quality bid of that magnitude signals recession panic, not the soft-landing bottom the pattern implies; invalidates macro setup

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
